data.timestamp_convention: Interval-end labels on the original date/period clock; no UTC or civil-time conversion.
data.target: Hourly mean OperationalLessIndustrial (MW); ALL_FIVE is its derived five-series sum.

compute.memory_measurement: RSS sampled after each horizon; not a continuous peak.

protocol: Models refit at each fold. Validation and training labels strictly precede fold origins. Observed history updates at each hourly test origin. Quantiles are sorted/nonnegative; independent node forecasts are not reconciled. No future weather or demand features.
